title: AI Customer Communication and Service Quality

questions.question: What is the main risk of AI-assisted service replies?
options: They can sound professional while source confidence, empathy, or escalation is weak
They always include too much empathy
questions.explanation: Service replies need evidence, tone, confidence, and escalation checks.

questions.question: Which signal is part of this lesson?
questions.explanation: SLA risk changes response priority and review level.

questions.question: What does the Python artifact produce?
options: A ranked customer-response quality plan with controls
questions.explanation: The artifact maps service signals to response controls.

questions.question: Which control belongs to this lesson?
questions.explanation: Escalation paths protect customers when confidence is low or impact is high.

questions.question: When should AI-assisted customer communication receive stronger review?
options: When customers are frustrated, response confidence is low, SLA is at risk, or escalation is needed
Only when no customer is affected
Only when the answer is fully certain
questions.explanation: These signals indicate higher service quality risk.

questions.question: What should be checked before sending an AI-assisted service reply?
options: Source, empathy, confidence threshold, and escalation path
questions.explanation: These checks keep customer communication accurate and accountable.
